<!--First analysis stage: rural vs urban wales worse score, statistical difference-->
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
```

## Step 1- Load master dataset, rural urban split
```{r}
master<- read_csv("../data/processed/master_dataset.csv") %>%
  mutate(rural_urban = factor(rural_urban, levels = c("Rural","Urban")))
rural <- master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Rural")
urban <- master %>% filter(rural_urban == "Urban")
cat("Rural:", nrow(rural), "| Urban:", nrow(urban), "\n")

```

## Step 2- Median rank per domain, rural vs urban
```{r domain_medians}
# median rank per domain, low rank= more deprived
domain_cols <- c("wimd_2025_rank", "income_rank", "employment_rank",
                 "health_rank", "education_rank", "access_rank",
                 "housing_rank", "community_safety_rank", "physical_env_rank")

master %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(domain_cols), ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

```

## Step 3- Mann- Whitney U test and effect size of every domain
```{r mann_whitney}
#Mann-whitney appropriate for rank data  and effect size for each domain

map_dfr(domain_cols, function(col) {
  test <- wilcox.test(rural[[col]], urban[[col]],
                      alternative="two.sided", exact=FALSE)
  z    <- qnorm(test$p.value / 2)
  tibble(
    domain       = col,
    rural_median = median(rural[[col]], na.rm=TRUE),
    urban_median = median(urban[[col]], na.rm=TRUE),
    effect_r     = round(abs(z) / sqrt(nrow(rural)+nrow(urban)), 3),
    rural_worse  = median(rural[[col]], na.rm=TRUE) < median(urban[[col]], na.rm=TRUE)
  )
}) %>% arrange(desc(effect_r))


```

## Step 4- The access rank gap:hidden deprivation  overall rank 
```{r access_rank_gap}
# access_rank_gap negative means LSOA is more deprived on access than overall rank 
master %>%
  group_by(rural_urban) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    median_gap   = round(median(access_rank_gap, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    pct_negative = round(100 * mean(access_rank_gap < 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

## Step 5- Weight gap- which group is worse
```{r weight_mismatch}
#For each domain whether rural urban is worse
weights <- tibble(
  domain      = c("income_rank", "employment_rank", "health_rank",
                  "education_rank", "access_rank", "housing_rank",
                  "community_safety_rank", "physical_env_rank"),
  wimd_weight = c(22, 20, 15, 14, 10, 9, 5, 5)
)
map_dfr(domain_cols[domain_cols != "wimd_2025_rank"], function(col) {
  tibble(domain = col,
         rural_worse = median(rural[[col]], na.rm=TRUE) <
                       median(urban[[col]], na.rm=TRUE))
}) %>%
  left_join(weights, by="domain") %>%
  group_by(rural_worse) %>%
  summarise(combined_weight = sum(wimd_weight), .groups="drop")

```

## Step 6- Deprivation on Access accross 6 RUV categories
```{r ruc_sensitivity}
# access deprivation by all 6 RUC categories
master %>%
  group_by(ruc_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n               = n(),
    median_access   = round(median(access_rank, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    pct_worst_20pct = round(100 * mean(access_rank <= 383, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(median_access)
```

## Step 7- Remoteness predict how access deprivation is hidden
```{r spearman_remoteness}
# rural areas; coded 4 RUC subcategoriesbeing more remote predict bigger gap between access and overall rank
master %>%
  mutate(remoteness = case_when(
    str_detect(ruc_name, "Larger rural.*Further")  ~ 4,
    str_detect(ruc_name, "Smaller rural.*Further")  ~ 3,
    str_detect(ruc_name, "Larger rural.*Nearer")    ~ 2,
    str_detect(ruc_name, "Smaller rural.*Nearer")   ~ 1
  )) %>%
  summarise(
    spearman_r = round(cor(remoteness, access_rank_gap,
                           method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3),
    n = sum(!is.na(remoteness) & !is.na(access_rank_gap))
  )



```
